details: For every finite binary concept class, $\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H^*)$.
proof: Transpose the incidence sign matrix. Proposition 1 gives that its dual sign rank is at least its VC dimension; dual sign rank is at most sign rank. Since sign rank is invariant under transposition, this yields $\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H^*)$.
name: Sign Rank / Dual VC Dimension
